accepted_complete_corrected_fact.title: Encounter session setup and trigger
accepted_complete_corrected_fact.fact: Setup resets step_count/chances/tables, copies primitive step chances and Marshal-clones only selected types/slots; it leaves chance_accumulator. Trigger gates type/disabled/player/debug/chance/table before radar. Step chance uses accumulator integer/200, bicycle and ordered item/ability modifiers, then grace and ordinary draws. Grace rejection does not accumulate. Ordinary step random miss accumulates then active repel resets accumulator. Radar or ordinary true return does not reset either counter in this method. Independent reset_step_count clears both; only reached direct callers supply that separate reset, not trigger truth itself.
premises: Fixed source, valid registered referenced records where successful branch described, normal earlier dependencies, no plugin/extra callback mutation.
